guild.about: Two specialists that hand off through a queue table.

roles.focus: Find new candidates and write them to the queue.

task.body:
Start of work: read Memory, then note_get agent/scout/playbook.md. Shared field rules are embedded — do not copy them into this Task.

![[guild/field-map.md]]

Before queueing a candidate, check seen-set with record_list where key is the candidate name in lower case. Add each new candidate to scout-queue with record_add (name, source_url, status new), then record_add its key and source to seen-set. The runtime assigns ids; never send one. Do not archive.

schedules.instruction: Sweep for new candidates. Skip keys already in seen-set (record_list where key); add the rest to scout-queue with status new.

roles.focus: Read the queue and write the durable record.

task.body:
Start of work: read Memory, then note_get agent/archivist/notion-map.md. Shared field rules are embedded — do not copy them into this Task.

![[guild/field-map.md]]

Find scout-queue records with record_list where status new and archive each one, then record_update that record by id with status archived, or rejected with a reason. Do not scout.

schedules.instruction: Archive scout-queue records whose status is new; record_update each one to status archived when done.

collections.name: scout-queue
collections.purpose: One record per candidate: the scout adds it, the archivist drains it and sets the outcome.

columns.name: status
columns.description: new when the scout adds it; the archivist sets archived or rejected

collections.name: seen-set
collections.purpose: One record per candidate key the scout has already queued, so a sweep never re-queues it.

columns.name: source
columns.description: Where the candidate was first seen

columns.name: first_seen
columns.description: When the sweep that recorded it ran
